title: Laughter from the Empty Room
description: You stop. From behind a door to your left comes the sound of a child laughing — clear and bright, the kind that belongs to summer afternoons and open fields. The door is ajar. Through the gap you can see bare floorboards, a fallen chair, nothing else. The laughter continues, unhurried, as though it does not know you are there. It has the texture of a memory that was never yours.

beats.description: The laughter continues. The door is ajar. You have not yet committed to anything.

choices.label: Walk past and do not look
choices.description: Keep your eyes on the passage ahead and your feet moving.

success.narrative: You round the corner and the sound falls away, swallowed by the manor's usual silence.

failure.narrative: You almost manage it, but something in the pitch of the laughter hooks behind your eyes and will not let go.

choices.label: Push the door open and look inside
choices.description: Step through and confront whatever is there.

success.narrative: The room is empty, as you knew it would be, and the silence that greets you is absolute — which is somehow worse than any sight could have been.

failure.narrative: The laughter stops the instant you enter, and in the silence you understand with total certainty that it was standing directly behind the door.

choices.label: Wait in the corridor and listen
choices.description: Hold still and let the sound run its course.

success.narrative: After a long while the laughter trails off into nothing, and you find your breathing has steadied without your noticing.

failure.narrative: You stand rigid for what might be minutes or hours; when it finally stops, something in you has gone quiet alongside it.

beats.description: The corridor ahead seems unchanged. But your neck prickles. Something may have come with you when the laughter stopped.

choices.label: Keep walking — do not look back
choices.description: Whatever it is, giving it your attention will not help.

success.narrative: You put distance between yourself and the door. The prickling fades, slowly.

choices.label: Turn and check the corridor
choices.description: Look once, clearly, and settle the question.

success.narrative: Nothing is there. The corridor is empty. You feel the certainty of it and it helps.

failure.narrative: Nothing is there — but in the moment between looking and being sure, something was.

beats.description: The room is empty. The silence here is different from the silence of the manor — total, without echo. A fallen chair lies on its side near the far wall.

choices.label: Leave immediately
choices.description: You have seen what there is to see.

success.narrative: You step back into the corridor and pull the door to. The silence stays behind it.

choices.label: Right the fallen chair
choices.description: A small act. Something that belongs upright should be upright.

success.narrative: The chair stands. The room does not object. You feel, briefly, that you have done something the room needed.

visual.alt_text: A dim corridor with a door standing slightly ajar, pale light falling on bare floorboards beyond. The room inside is visibly, completely empty.
